changes.to: WEILAN's AlphaDog E-Series page (alphadoge.html, read 2026-11-17) carries a 'Reference Specifications' table for the E300: speed up to 3 m/s, adjustable walking height 18-37 cm, adjustable width 20-32 cm, gradeability up to 20 degrees, payload up to 5 kg, V-SLAM, autonomous navigation and dynamic balancing. The maker publishes no mass, length, runtime, DoF or battery capacity for the E300, so those stay empty; third-party figures (13 kg, 3 h) are not used.
